text: "Materials and Chemical Engineering" is an interdisciplinary field that integrates materials science and chemical engineering. It focuses on the research, production, performance optimization of materials, and their application in chemical production. It also covers the selection, use, and recycling of materials in the chemical process. It not only pays attention to the structure and function of materials themselves, but also emphasizes the engineering process of converting materials into practical products. It is a key area that connects basic research and industrial applications.
